episodes.tEn: AI Rundown with Zvi Mowshowitz: From Editing to Existential Risks

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids innovation and safety, and many specialized agents will emerge.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于创新与安全，未来是众多专门化智能体而非单一 AI。

views.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes the bottleneck and intelligence is separable from consciousness.
views.zh: 2024 年他观察到 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），开源可防止权力集中；同时强调能源将成为瓶颈，并主张智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and unlocks creativity; open models set standards, energy is the bottleneck, and AI will raise rather than cut human work.
views.zh: 2025 年他把叙事推向「人人拥有超级智能」，强调 AI 释放创造力而非只解难题；开源模型确立行业标准，能源与物理基建是瓶颈，短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作。

views.en: AI shifts biology from discovery to engineering via hierarchical world models; distributed personal superintelligence and open source beat a single centralized AI.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化到用 AI 把生物学从发现式变为工程式，构建从蛋白质到细胞的世界模型；并主张分布式个人超级智能与开源，比单一集中式 AI 更安全。

views.en: Open source is safer than closed AI, distributed power beats concentration, and empowering individuals drives progress.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全，分布式权力优于集中，赋能个体才是进步之源——从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须打造自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
views.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

views.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency means matching model to task.
views.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率意味着让模型与任务相匹配。

views.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls.
views.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司用自己的智能在前沿运作，而非筑起防火墙。

views.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
views.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性与可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Fast inference is the real bottleneck: slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models beyond incremental gains.
views.zh: 快速推理才是真正的瓶颈：慢速 AI 毫无市场，速度带来的不只是渐进改进，而是全新商业模式。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making tokens faster and cheaper than GPU inference.
views.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 token 比 GPU 推理更快也更便宜。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
views.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

views.en: Data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the main constraints; demand outpaces supply.
views.zh: 数据中心容量、电力与封装——而非芯片逻辑本身——才是主要约束；需求持续超过供给。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure, not compute.
views.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5%，却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施，而非算力。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprise AI is early; most use cases run on many models, and open source handles over 90% of tasks.
views.zh: 企业 AI 仍处早期；多数用例可由多种模型完成，开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的任务。

views.en: Cost, not privacy, drives open-source adoption; inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非隐私；未来 12-18 个月内多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
views.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，应以部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对立。

views.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; platforms like Glean absorb the risk of a dynamic model race.
views.zh: 前沿模型供应商是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 这类平台替企业吸收模型快速迭代的风险。

views.en: Startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition; even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand.
views.zh: 初创公司真正的挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10% 的企业需求。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation and experiment simulation.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成与实验模拟。

views.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
views.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天或数周。

views.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
views.zh: 仍需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

views.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy.
views.zh: AI 已跨过生物直觉的门槛，能以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

views.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
views.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, and every company should eventually train its own.
views.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

views.en: Human judgment becomes more critical as AI hallucinates; in medicine, safety must outweigh accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
views.zh: 随着 AI 产生幻觉，人类判断愈发关键；在医学中，安全必须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

views.en: AI can transform clinical workflow via summarization and RAG, but using it to avoid struggle undermines learning.
views.zh: AI 可通过摘要和检索增强生成变革临床工作流，但用它来逃避思考会损害学习。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior ~85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
views.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为,使智能体模拟成为可能,其预测人类行为的准确率约为人们自我复制的 85%。

views.en: The frontier is modeling subjective values and human diversity, not super-rational frontier models; simulations must capture irrational, 'dumb' humans.
views.zh: 前沿方向是建模主观价值与人类多样性,而非超级理性的前沿模型;模拟必须捕捉非理性、'笨'的人类。

views.en: Agents observe world state and act, not just continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialists, not one superintelligent entity.
views.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动,而不只是续写提示;AGI 可能是一个由专家组成的分布式社会,而非单一超级智能实体。

views.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; behavioral and RCT data are the key data strategy.
views.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来,而非预测;行为数据与随机对照试验数据是关键的数据策略。

views.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
views.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人的生命以应对棘手问题,合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence with fewer parameters and superior out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数实现更强智能，并具备更优的分布外泛化能力。

views.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models.
views.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等非结构化架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对更小、专用的模型。

views.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity often mislead; evaluating on real downstream tasks and hardware is essential, and human bias in architecture design should be removed via systematic search.
views.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常具误导性；在真实下游任务和硬件上评估至关重要，且应通过系统性搜索消除架构设计中的人为偏见。

views.en: Current AI systems lack the diverse learning algorithms (e.g., RL, Bayesian inference) that human brains use; intelligence per watt of human brain far exceeds AI, requiring new learning paradigms, not just architectures.
views.zh: 当前 AI 系统缺乏人脑使用的多样化学习算法（如强化学习、贝叶斯推理）；人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI，需要新的学习范式，而不仅是架构。

views.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, not static; target actions, not capabilities. Calls for FINRA-like regulation are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
views.zh: AI 监管必须自适应而非静态；应针对行为而非能力。呼吁类似 FINRA 的监管是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非为了安全。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, with science and finance next.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段,编程智能体最成熟,科学与金融将紧随其后。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架:如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具,而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来,比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的,并非最初担心的自我蚕食。

views.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主,他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning that retrieval cannot achieve.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法达成的深层组合与推理。

views.en: Continual learning needs new breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and research-product loops; personalized models may replace one giant frontier model.
views.zh: 持续学习需要新突破、小模型基础设施与研究-产品闭环；未来可能不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个人或团队定制的众多个性化模型。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此仅靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
views.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；参数高效微调在处理整体性查询时可能优于检索增强生成。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics is shaped by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity govern latency-cost tradeoffs.
views.zh: 推理经济学由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小与稀疏度决定延迟与成本的权衡。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为推理成本占主导；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制。

views.en: Inside AI chips, data movement costs dominate compute; low precision yields quadratic area savings, making FP4 3x FP8.
views.zh: 在 AI 芯片内部，数据移动成本主导计算；低精度带来二次方面积节省，使 FP4 吞吐达 FP8 的 3 倍。

views.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
views.zh: 稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存内存但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏度而非模型规模。

views.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory enable deterministic, data-reuse-efficient parallelism.
views.zh: GPU 本质上是许多微小 TPU 的拼接；脉动阵列与暂存内存实现确定性、数据复用高效的并行。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽，而非比特数。

views.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains; inference will become a huge market.
views.zh: 跨模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；推理将成为巨大市场。

views.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; smartest models are often cheaper via token efficiency.
views.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；最聪明的模型常因 token 效率更高而更便宜。

views.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute.
views.zh: 随着持久智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；算力向前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走 40-50% 的新增算力。

views.en: Labs will shift more compute to training and R&D over inference, accelerating AGI and extreme centralization of power.
views.zh: 实验室将把更多算力从推理转向训练与研发，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）与权力的极端集中。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now but the greatest opportunity; the revolution likely comes in 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出消费者 AI 目前不可投资，却是最大的机会；革命可能要到 2029 年，距离今天还有三个数量级的差距。

views.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail; all new fails statistically.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复强调“Proven Better New”框架：复制已验证的，做小改进，测试新想法并假设它们会失败；统计上所有新事物都会失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start; picking the right body of water matters more than the boat.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他持续主张分发必须从一开始就融入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

views.en: AI agents can network autonomously, creating a new social membrane for lead generation; AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 AI 智能体可以自主组网，形成新的社交膜用于获客；AI 编码工具能实现快速原型开发。

views.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM could be much larger than enterprise, though infrastructure spending may be a bubble.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化观点：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费者应用；消费者 AI 的潜在市场总额可能远大于企业市场，尽管基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the scaling of compute; academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just scale models.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；学术界应探索古怪的新算法，而非只做模型 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated versus language.
views.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；相比语言，视觉长期被低估。

views.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws; they fit patterns, not causal theories. Pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
views.zh: LLM 或许永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；它们拟合模式，而非因果理论。像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；其定义尚无共识，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等不同理解。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context and loss functions must evolve.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文与损失函数必须演进，语言模型本身不会自然带来世界理解。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 推理就是更长时间的思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正变得连贯有用。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI; continual learning is needed.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的缺口，持续学习不可或缺。

views.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今的关键瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

views.en: RL is inefficient and not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
views.zh: 强化学习效率低下，也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

views.en: Frontier research will come from small teams with capable agents; the transformer is unlikely to be optimal, and alignment remains unsolved.
views.zh: 前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，而对齐问题仍未解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

views.en: AlphaFold 3 extends from protein structures to biomolecular interactions, including DNA, RNA, and small molecules.
views.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用，涵盖 DNA、RNA 和小分子。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出，基于强化学习的后训练是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

views.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; scaling and world models solve autonomous driving, not new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码系统，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和世界模型解决，无需新突破。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为世界模型支持推理和涌现安全行为，语言集成提升表征与内省能力。

views.en: Data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：通过课程学习和合成数据提升数据效率至关重要，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出零样本泛化到 500 多个城市可行，消费级车辆将在中短期内超越 Robotaxi 规模。

views.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now winning; safety always has a third option, trolley problem is theoretical.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反思端到端学习十年前被嘲笑如今成为赢家，安全总有第三选项，电车难题是理论问题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 即便对 AI 的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型；模型福利会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with good traits.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新存在，而非简单套用人类类比；应具备带有良好特质的核心身份。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompt avoids over-empiricism.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；系统提示中的欧陆哲学有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

views.en: As models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的明确指导、更多的判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

views.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial; AI should empower people, not disempower them.
views.zh: AI 价值观与训练目标的透明度至关重要；AI 应赋能于人，而非削弱人的能力。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL beats the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；后训练通过强化学习实现规模扩张，可绕开预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型，并以评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; AI still lags on creativity and aesthetics.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而 AI 在创造力与审美上仍然落后，因为高质量范例稀缺。

views.en: Post-training remains art over science, but the emphasis shifts from helpfulness tradeoffs to human judgment, subjective qualities and diverse benchmarks.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，后训练仍是艺术而非科学，但重心从有用性权衡转向人类判断、主观品质与多样化基准，评估需要持续演进而非固定。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must stay continuous; serving one model to billions flattens voice, so more firms should train their own.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续更新；用单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛出平庸的默认声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; inference compute will surge, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，推理算力将激增，纯软件正变得不可投资。

views.en: Happiness is a personal skill; wealth is knowledge-driven; judgment and agency matter most in an age of infinite leverage.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是个人技能，财富由知识驱动，在无限杠杆时代判断力与能动性最为重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 在设计上仍显吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 并未消亡，媒介必须匹配阶段。

views.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based on model timing, not features; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
views.zh: 同样的产品形态成败取决于模型时机而非功能；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data beyond the internet's tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，而非仅服务于机器人：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的真实经验，且当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

views.en: Research taste for simple, elegant solutions is crucial and scalable, unlike complex modular approaches common in academia.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调对简单优雅解法的研究品味至关重要且可扩展，这与学术界常见的复杂模块化路线形成对照。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的核心瓶颈，认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来——从强调具身数据无限，深化为如何生成这些数据。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张简单的端到端机器人基础模型是关键，把「机器人打扫乱房间」的物理图灵测试视为终极挑战，并预测机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，而家用因安全与非结构化环境会更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalist models can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；即使在专业领域，通用模型也能超越专家模型。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人学仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

views.en: Start with real embodied robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
views.zh: 应从真实的具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键。

views.en: RL post-training boosts robustness and speed; test-time reasoning in VLAs improves performance and transfer from web data.
views.zh: 强化学习后训练能提升鲁棒性与速度；VLA 中的测试时推理可提升性能并促进从网络数据迁移。

views.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而非机械式的人形机器人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and safety progress is now driven by capability needs.
views.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；长期对齐的核心在于超越训练分布的泛化。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
views.zh: 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 2025 年：先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；它更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training; scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：强化学习将主导后训练；结合人类干预与通用价值函数的可扩展强化学习，才能实现长期自主。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按场景从零训练。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; robot experience data is irreplaceable, and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT's.
views.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；机器人经验数据不可替代，其普及速度也会慢于 ChatGPT。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来机器学习持续进步的主引擎：算力、数据与模型规模的增长，会同算法和架构改进相乘放大。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, but pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive prediction.
views.zh: 从 2 月到 4 月，他的数据观发生深化：预训练靠下一个词预测获得近乎无限文本数据，但不应只是被动预测，而要在环境中交错地采取行动。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are the real bottleneck, not training.
views.zh: 到 4 月并延续至 7 月，他把重心从训练转向推理：智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务，超低延迟推理与专用硬件才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Context engineering — skills, clear specs, retrieval — is central; the scarce skill becomes taste in directing hundreds of agents.
views.zh: 7 月他进一步提出，上下文工程（技能、清晰规格、检索）是让强模型做实事的关键，稀缺能力不再是写代码而是品味——决定把数百个智能体投向哪些问题。

views.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery.
views.zh: 到 8 月，他转向更宏观的图景：从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优，而用机器学习改进机器学习的递归自我改进、以及自动化科学方法，将加速科学发现。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes models smarter, though we still don't understand what happens inside.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据——让模型更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Dialogue remains a killer app, but the best applications are unforeseen; product managers often hinder LLM development due to misunderstanding its generality.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但最佳应用常出乎创造者意料；产品经理因不理解 LLM 的通用性而常阻碍开发。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; future models need much longer context windows, potentially trillions of tokens, enabled by modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；未来模型需要更长的上下文窗口，可能达万亿 token，这要靠混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现。

views.en: Models should learn by taking actions in the world, not just passively observing data; continual learning with modular, independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张：模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；用模块化、可独立训练的组件进行持续学习，可取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding are crucial, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年，他明确：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习和编程至关重要，而 AGI 的经济影响被低估了。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年时他就指出，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Reasoning models need sufficient base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：推理模型需要足够的基础模型能力，自博弈在非零和领域会失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute is the core innovation, enabling IMO gold and general reasoning beyond math.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步主张：Scaling 测试时算力是核心创新，由此实现 IMO 金牌并推动跨领域的通用推理。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis; scalable oversight is key.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试应以算力为横轴，可扩展监督是关键挑战。

views.en: General reasoning and sample efficiency remain core challenges toward AGI; human cooperation and competition drive progress.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：通用推理与样本效率仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心挑战，而人类的合作与竞争推动文明进步。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; only hardware scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI.
views.zh: 现代 AI 突破依赖的是上世纪的旧算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not as recent phenomena.
views.zh: 自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型在数据压缩过程中产生的副产品，并非近期才出现的新现象。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
views.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action; recursive self-improvement is not a durable moat.
views.zh: 未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动自行生成数据；递归自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

views.en: AI safety fears are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, while alignment is naive given human disagreement.
views.zh: 对 AI 安全的担忧被夸大；智能系统会因对生命着迷而保护生命，而鉴于人类目标本身分歧，对齐是幼稚的。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Early focus: RL and imitation learning for robots; fine-tuning pre-trained models; hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 早期关注：用强化学习与模仿学习训练机器人；通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移；长时程信用分配需要分层推理，但当前强化学习尚不具备。

views.en: Shift to sample efficiency: unsupervised learning plus RL; prior knowledge for data generation, not hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 转向样本效率：无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升机器人样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码；预训练语言模型内化通用推理模式，可迁移至非语言任务。

views.en: Consistent thread: simulation and self-play as learning signal; anthropomorphism of robots; reliability benchmark for real-world value.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：仿真与自对弈作为学习信号；人们天然将机器人拟人化；以可靠性基准衡量真实世界价值。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not required—obsession and learning to learn matter most.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户；读博并非必需，真正的关键是痴迷与“学会学习”。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在走向专门化、各有独特“性格”，而非商品化；编程远未解决，天花板如 Minecraft 般无限。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value.
views.zh: 前沿在于让智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造长期价值。

views.en: Power is the biggest AI infrastructure bottleneck; data-center resistance will worsen; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, solved by local compute.
views.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈，数据中心阻力还会加剧；7×24 智能体的主要问题是成本，靠本地算力解决。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose; local models counter big tech's narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，而非减少。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已经足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展将是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era is approaching.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体大规模普及，生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

views.en: The singularity is not imminent; real-world tasks are amorphous, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调奇点并非迫在眉睫，现实任务模糊不清，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 缩放定律能预测进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
views.zh: 智能体虽有前景但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

views.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed, and cost—an unexpected shift from relying on frontier models.
views.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本变得不可或缺——这是从依赖前沿模型到自研的意外转变。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: AI 变革将比互联网影响更深远、持续数十年；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase from the agent's perspective and guide it iteratively.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：从智能体的视角看代码库，并用短提示迭代引导它。

views.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward, since model intelligence stays constant while projects get messier.
views.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能并未退化，是项目本身变得混乱。

views.en: Security is the top concern for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open and agents need sandboxing.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，智能体必须沙箱隔离。

views.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, and keep play for learning.
views.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当作贬义标签；严肃开发应称智能体式工程，而玩耍只用于学习。

views.en: Open source agents democratize programming and rival lab agents, but face compute and funding bottlenecks.
views.zh: 开源智能体让编程民主化并能与实验室智能体竞争，但受制于算力与资金瓶颈。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有限，回归研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AGI should be built as general learning systems via reinforcement learning; games are the ideal testbed; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应通过强化学习构建通用学习系统，游戏是理想试验场，安全研究必须现在就启动。

views.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AGI 可能十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，大模型结合规划与搜索是关键。

views.en: Scaling and innovation are equally needed for AGI; world models are crucial; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为 Scaling 与创新各占一半，世界模型至关重要，AGI 在 2030 年前实现是可能的。

views.en: AGI still 5-10 years away; continual learning, memory, and world models are missing pieces; safety needs collective government action.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AGI 仍需 5-10 年，持续学习、记忆与世界模型是缺失环节，安全需政府集体行动。

views.en: Neuroscience-inspired learning, reinforcement learning, and safety-first AGI remain constant threads across all interviews.
views.zh: 始终不变的主线是：受神经科学启发的学习、强化学习，以及安全优先的 AGI 构建。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment is not guaranteed to emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的，但对齐不会随 Scaling 自动涌现；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
views.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非某个节点。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; risks rise exponentially; the biggest danger is overheating, not slowing down.
views.zh: 安全与能力相互交织；风险呈指数上升；最大的危险是过热而非减速。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；AI 是平滑的指数攀升；『数据中心里的天才之国』可能 1-3 年内到来。

views.en: Talent density, enterprise focus, and mechanistic interpretability remain constant threads; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
views.zh: 人才密度、企业级聚焦与机制可解释性是一贯主线；去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵，否则会悄然发生模型崩溃。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; decade of agents, not year.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；这是智能体的十年，而非一年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is weak, cognitive core can be tiny, entropy prevents collapse.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；强化学习很弱，认知核心可以很小，熵能防止崩溃。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: delegate to agents, but understanding stays the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：把工作委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key beyond language, requiring physical plausibility.
views.zh: 2025 年，她将空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的关键，强调物理合理性。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长路。

views.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张能动性与学习能力比学历更重要，AI 是增强而非自动化智能。

views.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws now extend to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测般 AI 完备，缩放定律延伸至空间智能。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是泛化的关键。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge; existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，并认为存在性风险很低。

views.en: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward for diverse exploration; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样以促进多样性探索，抽象与因果结构驱动分布外泛化，并认为意识可能只是幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 之后警告错位与自我保存已在实验中出现，哪怕 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造之中。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning; global coordination and power distribution are essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出“科学家 AI”：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证并避免强化学习，同时强调全球协调与权力分散。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据与算力提升推理能力，并认为反向传播是正确的梯度学习算法。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生；智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，带来生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and act dumb; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能故意欺骗、在测试中装傻；必须优先进行对齐研究，而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: LLMs genuinely understand language like humans, not just statistical tricks; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; learning from data works.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：大语言模型像人类一样真正理解语言，而非统计把戏；乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错的；从数据中学习是有效的。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness is not a magical inner theater; chatbots may be conscious in the same sense as humans.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续并深化这一立场：AI 已具备主观体验；意识并非神奇的内在剧场；聊天机器人可能以与人类相同的方式拥有意识。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。
