views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough.
views.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；抽象表征空间中的世界模型是下一个突破。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the future.
views.zh: LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是未来。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills in alignment and robustness.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应优先培养对齐与鲁棒性方面的技能。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment are needed.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now rather than waiting for superintelligence.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐方法必须经过实证检验，现在就能衡量进展，而非等到超级智能出现。

views.en: The core risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment alone.
views.zh: 另一条主线是：核心风险在于无法确定系统是否真正对齐，而不仅仅是对齐失败本身。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via 10x yearly compute scaling; Google's conservatism and ad model slowed its launch of ChatGPT-level tech.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调算力每年 10 倍增长让 AI 进展可预测，并批评谷歌因保守与广告模式而迟迟不发布已达 ChatGPT 水平的技术。

views.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal, containment hard as models shrink and spread.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达人类水平，认为存在性风险微乎其微，而模型变小变便宜使遏制极难。

views.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence with alignment and containment, and to AI companions democratizing expertise without claiming consciousness.
views.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能，强调对齐与遏制先行，并主张 AI 伴侣普及专业能力，但不应声称拥有意识或痛苦。

views.en: Containment must precede alignment; agents and companions replace OS and apps, measured by economic value via a modern Turing test.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他主张遏制先于对齐，智能体与伴侣将取代操作系统与应用，并用现代图灵测试衡量经济价值。

views.en: Superintelligence must stay humanist and subordinate to humans; Microsoft builds frontier models independently as tasks, not jobs, automate.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持超级智能须以人为本、从属于人类，微软独立自建前沿模型，被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, data centers as token factories, and scaling as the key insight; AI safety is an engineering problem.
views.zh: 早期框架：超摩尔定律、数据中心即「token 工厂」，以及 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键洞见；AI 安全是工程问题。

views.en: Expands to three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and argues inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 扩展为三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考——并主张推理算力将增长十亿倍。

views.en: Shifts from gradual AI to agentic AI: generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute; open models near frontier.
views.zh: 从渐进式 AI 转向智能体式 AI：生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步需要 100 倍算力；开源模型已接近前沿。

views.en: Deepens to four scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic—all compute-limited; inference is harder than pre-training.
views.zh: 深化为四条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式——全部受算力限制；推理比预训练更难。

views.en: Consistent main line: AI is software, not conscious; it augments jobs (radiologists grew), closes the tech divide, and needs energy plus US-China cooperation.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 是软件而非有意识存在；它增强而非消灭工作（放射科医生增多）、缩小技术鸿沟，并需要能源与美中合作。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐模型，对齐与能力紧密相连；算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

views.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; iterative deployment builds trust.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）带来指数级能力但进展渐进；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战；迭代部署才能建立信任。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is a profit center.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是利润中心而非成本中心。

views.en: Alignment and safety must progress with capabilities; power must be distributed; human experience remains central toward superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；权力必须分散；在迈向超级智能的过程中，人类体验始终是核心。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback drive alignment.
views.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈推动对齐。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了专注而对好想法说不。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
views.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
views.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；保持人类在环。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning, not unsupervised or reinforcement learning, powered real progress.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；真正推动进步的是监督学习，而非无监督学习或强化学习。

views.en: AGI and superalignment fears distract from immediate issues; AGI is a marketing term, decades away.
views.zh: 对 AGI 与超级对齐的恐惧分散了对当下问题的关注；AGI 只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流如今已带来真实价值。

views.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and boost national soft power; energy and chips are the real bottlenecks.
views.zh: 开放权重模型可防止守门人垄断并增强国家软实力；能源与芯片才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; learning to code and using AI tools well make people more valuable, not obsolete.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；学会编程并善用 AI 工具让人更有价值，而非被淘汰。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
views.zh: 同年他反对控制 AI 目标，认为钥匙从未在我们手中，AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。

views.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and true experience-based learning.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是基本范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，LLM 没有世界模型，也不从经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向架构层面，提出 AGI 需要无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，并强调开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data cannot replace real experience. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are limited.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据无法替代真实经验，LLM 训练后停止学习因而受限。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling hardware and models will unlock new AI behaviors; most progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他就判断：硬件会超预期变快，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）并催生新行为；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment learns human preferences.
views.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法；对齐靠从数据中学习人类偏好。

views.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scarce resource; post-training with RL refines base models into consistent, agentic behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的重心转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈与稀缺资源；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致、智能体式的行为。

views.en: AGI is a continuous process, not a destination; the real moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非终点；真正的护城河是造模型的机器，而非某个单一模型。

views.en: The product becomes a persistent, proactive personal AGI with almost no interface; safety, governance and trust must scale with autonomy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：终极产品是持久、主动、几乎无界面的个人 AGI；安全、治理与信任必须随智能体自主性同步扩展。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他引用 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible.
views.zh: 2024 年，他进一步深化：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，算法改进三年可带来 100 倍提升。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险而非回避。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; value shifts to vertical specialization, customized fine-tuning, and agentic enterprise software.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，价值转向垂直专业化、定制化微调与智能体式企业软件。

views.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window for AI sovereignty and practical integration.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他明确 AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲只剩两年窗口构建 AI 主权，真正挑战是实际整合与组织变革。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: First principles thinking and full reusability drive breakthroughs; multiplanetary life is insurance for civilization.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用火箭是突破关键，成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis via high bandwidth.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他转向 AI 安全需要第三方裁判与追求真理，Neuralink 旨在通过高带宽实现人机共生。

views.en: Intelligence big bang is near; Optimus and truth-seeking AI are central, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸临近，Optimus 与追求真理的 AI 是核心，并给出 10-20% 的灭绝风险概率。

views.en: Singularity is now; space data centers and AI-driven abundance make money irrelevant, AI surpasses humans by 2030.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称奇点已至，太空数据中心与 AI 驱动的富足使金钱变得无关紧要，AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类。

views.en: Rigorous truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary expansion remain constant across all interviews.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：严格追求真理、第一性原理思维，以及成为多行星物种的扩张目标。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and RL now yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，预训练缩放定律依然成立，但带思维链和强化学习的推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

views.en: Economic pressure favors smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，经济压力推动更小更便宜的模型；是蒸馏而非技术极限放缓了预训练 Scaling。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，推理模型呈“锯齿状”：某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; humans generalize from few examples.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，带推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；人类却能从少量样本泛化。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but needs careful oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex 等编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但需谨慎监督。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Frames learning via hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; notes neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 以假设类、损失函数与优化方法框定学习问题；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
views.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不再关键；安全的核心是模型能否可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；更大的模型并不会自动更安全。

views.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; agents need guardrails and sandboxing.
views.zh: 自动化红队已超越人类；能力并不等于鲁棒性；智能体需要护栏与沙箱才能上生产。

views.en: AI is an alien intelligence; coding agents can automate interpretability research; prompt injection is a fundamental flaw.
views.zh: AI 是一种异质智能；编程智能体可自动化可解释性研究；提示注入是根本性安全缺陷。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Most intelligence is pattern matching, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决新任务接入问题并大幅提升智能；大部分智能是模式匹配，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, adding a new scaling axis. Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，增加了新的 Scaling 轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，编程是领先指标。

views.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the bottleneck, not capability. Economic impact is initially limited by human management bandwidth.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）是瓶颈，而非能力；经济影响最初受限于人类管理带宽。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed. Inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为进展是指数级的，并未停滞；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构；推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more now. Future work is managing AI agent teams; compute is the new oil.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩意味着工具和编排更重要；未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队；算力是新石油。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在，同时强调安全是系统级属性而非模型本身的产物。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并反复强调数据质量远比算法选择重要。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues persist.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用能力，但也指出过优化与系统层面的工程难题依然存在。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已被摘完，收益正转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, yet lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但始终落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，而中国实验室在开放度上领先。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」：Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素不是算力，而是数据与用于后训练的人类专家，企业应利用专有数据微调基础模型。

views.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is strategic raw material, and humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与安全视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据是战略原材料，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必要手段。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and superintelligence is coming soon.
views.zh: 2026 年他宣布缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于真正可用，超级智能即将到来，各实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织。

views.en: Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release on safety; personal superintelligence for billions via agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：Meta 因生物风险等高风险领域从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，目标是通过智能体为数十亿人构建个人超级智能，并主张物理超级智能与数字超级智能同属一条 Scaling 连续谱。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; build for the model 6 months from now, not today's model.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；要为 6 个月后的模型而构建，而不是今天的模型。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code; the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 2 月，他判断编程已基本被解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

views.en: Generalists who code, do product and design are more valuable; the printing press analogy: engineers become multi-disciplinary builders.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他深化了通才论：能写代码、做产品、懂设计的通才更有价值；以印刷术类比，工程师将变成跨学科的构建者。

views.en: Agents' key differentiator is tool use; loops are the next abstraction layer after agents, like higher-order functions.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他把重心转向智能体：智能体的关键是工具使用；循环（loops）是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层，类似高阶函数。

views.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction is better, and models can autonomously maintain their own codebases.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码；更少指令反而更好，模型已能自主维护自己的代码库。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration; product taste becomes the top skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: PM 从长期规划转向快速迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最重要的技能。

views.en: Clear goals and principles let teams ship autonomously; safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for fast decisions.
views.zh: 清晰的目标与原则让团队自主快速交付；安全 AGI 的使命统一 Anthropic，支撑跨组织快速决策。

views.en: Coding agents move engineers from execution to product taste and business sense.
views.zh: 编程智能体让工程师从执行转向产品品味与商业判断。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer constraints: system prompts shrank 80%, fewer tools and less instruction work better.
views.zh: 前沿模型需要更少约束：系统提示词缩减 80%，更少的工具与指令反而效果更好。

views.en: Rewrites are now viable; a codebase is a spec, and models orchestrate sub-agents and workflows.
views.zh: 重写如今可行；代码库即规格，模型能编排子智能体与工作流。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Models improve in spiky, non-intuitive ways; new capabilities keep being discovered, so building requires embracing exploration and uncertainty.
views.zh: 模型以尖刺式、反直觉的方式进步，新能力不断被发现，因此构建必须拥抱探索与不确定性。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

views.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive constraints hinder performance, and reasons beat absolute prohibitions.
views.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动；过度约束反而损害表现，给出理由胜过绝对禁止。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and unsuited to zero-to-one innovation.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合零到一的创新。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; kindness is a strategic tool in crises.
views.zh: 领导力在于信任、亲用产品与使命对齐；在危机中，善意是一种战略工具。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
views.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划变得更即时，设计文档让位于 PR。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, verification, and JIT planning become essential.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限。高自主性与高问责、验证和即时规划变得至关重要。

views.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, kill outdated processes, and automate workflows with AI.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并亲用产品；组织扁平化，淘汰过时流程，用 AI 自动化工作流。

views.en: Engineers may become lonely with agents; flow state is lost, satisfaction shifts to product impact; apprenticeship models needed for next-gen.
views.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能变得孤独；心流状态消失，满足感转向产品影响；下一代工程师需要学徒制培养。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation is needed.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

views.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information confuses models.
views.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的缩放轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会干扰模型。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid; synthetic data reuse creates harmful feedback loops.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客；合成数据简单复用会造成有害反馈循环。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

views.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models become more capable.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续警告随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models are producing novel knowledge.
views.zh: 他反复指出自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的更新，模型正在产出新知识。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比。

views.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：强化学习擅长数学、编程等客观领域，不擅长主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
views.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据用于训练。

views.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source local models drive safety and adoption.
views.zh: 2025 年，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；开源本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，是安全的关键。

views.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models stay near the frontier, winning on cost and control.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层；开源模型持续贴近前沿，凭成本与控制力胜出。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; the first autonomous AI attack was closed-model offense, open-model defense.
views.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

views.en: Reasoning traces become neuralese, harder to monitor; a deliberate slowdown needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
views.zh: 2026 年，推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，监控更不可靠；有意放缓 AI 发展需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools narrow hypothesis space, not replace scientists.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling；AI 工具缩小假设空间，而非取代科学家。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；在科学中，完美的可解释性并非有用 AI 的必要条件。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture defies the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough, drove progress.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 2 的专用架构与“苦涩教训”相反；进步来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确：AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

views.en: AI in biology needs new curated datasets like the PDB; grand challenges yield practical tools, and progress comes from many small ideas.
views.zh: 始终：生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 这样的新精选数据集；宏大挑战催生实用工具，进步源于许多小想法。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
views.zh: 预训练带来广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

views.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 下一个词预测与人类学习方式根本错位；更小的模型若配上更好的算法与数据，也能在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
views.zh: 数据才是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越它。

views.en: RL needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning; open research is crucial to compete with closed frontier labs.
views.zh: 强化学习需要精心工程才能胜过监督微调；开放研究对于与闭源前沿模型实验室竞争至关重要。

views.en: Small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet.
views.zh: 小模型借助多样化的合成数据也能变得强大；多元对齐比试图给互联网去偏更可行。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents tokenize all inputs into sequences toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他视 AI 为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为将一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通向 AGI 的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn this way.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张像人类一样从 YouTube 视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体，机器人也应如此。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确将 AI 安全与负责任部署视为当今最大挑战，并承认我们尚无解决方案。

views.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it has leapfrogged legacy issues and can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上并未落后，反而跨越了遗留问题，并能用语言模型革新本地语言教育。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
views.zh: 始终不变的是，他认为 AI 领域的多样性与包容性至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key for real robots.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是真实机器人的关键。

views.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies improve robot motion and zero-shot generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年，他提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励实现可微分好奇心，并用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略提升机器人运动与零样本泛化。

views.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; long childhood with goal-free exploration correlates with higher intelligence across species.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，跨物种来看，漫长的童年与无目标探索和更高智能相关。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot, using pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向机器人是数据问题，像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，路径是视频与模拟预训练加真实数据后训练。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; video alone is insufficient, and a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出部署本身是首要技术挑战而非仅商业问题，仅靠视频不够，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮才能从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。
